metadata.artifact_title: DeepSeek Harness ADR-10: Scoped Coeffect and Realm Architecture

source_and_baselines.source_title: Shi, Zhang, and Cui, A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability

decision.summary: Use a typed two-layer resolver, a persistent derived scoped context, explicit metadata precedence, and a one-way flat embedding.

semantic.shape: ResolverSpec M := forall k, RealmRef M k -> Prop
semantic.meaning: Admissibility relation; may be abstract or nondeterministic.
semantic.refinement_obligation: An executable choice must be shown to satisfy the supplied relation.

executable.shape: total resolve : (k : K) -> RealmRef M k plus finite override support
executable.meaning: One selected physical realm for every logical key.
executable.type_safety: RealmRef carries keyOf token = logical key, so dependent values are transported only with a visible witness.
executable.freshness_default: Keys outside overrideKeys resolve to the model default realm.

typed_realm_model.transport: Eq.mp/Eq.mpr along key_eq; no unchecked cast or heterogeneous V_r to V_k coercion

resolver_update.implementation_status: abstract interface; concrete update belongs to P5/ADR-02 integration

scoped_operations.lookup: resolve k, lookup physical token, then transport the value through key_eq
scoped_operations.insert: resolve k, transport V k back to the selected physical value type, insert at captured token
scoped_operations.inverse_boundary: A write inverse captures the token selected at forward application; it never recomputes a later resolver.
scoped_operations.frame_premise: PhysicalDistinct rho k j is required; logical-key inequality alone is insufficient under aliasing.

metadata.algebra: Per-key MetaAlgebra with empty, merge, left identity, right identity, and associativity.
metadata.provider_order: merge declared metadata with context metadata: declared(k) then contextMeta(k); right operand has precedence.
metadata.intercept_order: merge inherited metadata with new metadata: inherited(k) then new(k); new operand has precedence.
metadata.presence: InterceptionSpec stores Option (Meta k) separately from finite support; presence is not conflated with a metadata value.
metadata.priority_law: MetadataPrecedence.right_wins is explicit; monoid laws alone do not imply right bias.

persistent_context.derive_isolate: Returns a child with changed resolver and definitionally unchanged realms/contextMeta.
persistent_context.derive_intercept: Returns a child with changed contextMeta and definitionally unchanged resolver/realms.
persistent_context.realization_boundary: Persistent/derived semantics is core; object identity and in-place mutation are refinement concerns.

flat_embedding.non_claim: Arbitrary realm configurations are not asserted to flatten faithfully.
